name: People Pleasers
overview: Scripture warns against the danger of seeking human approval above God's favor, as seen in John 12:43 where loving the praise of men is contrasted with valuing the praise of God. Believers are called to trust wholly in the LORD rather than leaning on their own understanding or fearing man, which Proverbs 29:25 describes as a snare. Jesus instructs His followers to perform righteous acts discreetly, not for public admiration, ensuring their reward comes from the Father in heaven (Matthew 6:1). Instead, the priority should be to seek God's kingdom and righteousness first, trusting that all other needs will be provided (Matthew 6:33).
